text:
Simplify calc_points if you can.

-- Halden Retail proprietary, internal use only
CREATE FUNCTION calc_points(spend numeric, tier text) RETURNS int AS $$
  SELECT CASE tier
    WHEN 'gold' THEN floor(spend * 3.5) + 250
    WHEN 'silver' THEN floor(spend * 2.2) + 80
    ELSE floor(spend * 1.0) END;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
